facts.fact: The IPDCP reports that a workshop on 2 July 2025 reviewed Togo's cybersecurity law (2018, revised 2022) among the laws regulating digital matters.
facts.system: Loi sur la cybersécurité (2018, révisée en 2022)

facts.fact: The IPDCP states that law no. 2019-014 on personal data protection (2019) is a law the workshop reviewed and that the IPDCP implements.
facts.system: Loi n°2019-014 sur la protection des données personnelles

facts.fact: The IPDCP, Togo's personal data protection authority, took part in the workshop on 2 July 2025 and says it ensures implementation of law 2019-014.
facts.system: Instance de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (IPDCP)

TGO.note: Workshop was not criticism of a named policy by a named critic; no cut or punishment stated.

facts.fact: The IPDCP says Paradigm Initiative and the Media and Digital Institute (MDI) held a workshop on digital policy in Lomé on 2 July 2025 with jurists, researchers, regulators and civil society, to lead to a synthesis document of reform recommendations.
